description.value:
Requirement You are already performing a bio-augment graft or removal on the patient.

Fold a bio-augment's Load walk-back into a graft or removal you're already performing, at no extra downtime.

When you are already at the table performing a graft or removal on a patient, you may also perform a Load walk-back — pulling a different bio-augment already in them to lower their Load — in the same sitting. The two recoveries run concurrently instead of stacking, so the patient is enfeebled and drained for whichever Grade is higher, not both added together. The walk-back is otherwise an ordinary removal: the pulled tissue is destroyed and its Resonance stays exactly where it was.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, Load has no rule-element representation for a concurrent walk-back to apply against.
